verses.1: I, Paul, beg you to do this out of the greatness and generosity of Christ. He, who was humble in front of you, yet still has the courage to come to you.
verses.2: I also demand that they not be afraid of the belief in this matter. I consider it an act of courage to dare those who consider us to be walking on the surface of the flesh.
verses.3: For we cannot fight in the flesh; we must move through the flesh.
verses.4: For the weapons of our army are not fleshly things, but rather they are powerful instruments in the hands of God for strengthening our forces. They serve as tools for strengthening our strength.
verses.5: And every kind of pride that is contrary to God’s knowledge, and every meaning that hinders obedience to Christ, should be rejected.
verses.6: And with an intention to inflict all kinds of harm upon others, once your obedience is fulfilled.
verses.7: You can see it in their faces. If anyone truly wants to be Christ, then I think it’s important for them to remember that just as they are Christ, so also are we.
verses.8: For if I boast too much about our authority, which the Lord has given us for the building of houses, not for your use, then I will not be accused.
verses.9: So that you won’t be seen as those who are afraid of the letters.
verses.10: For, as it is said, the epistles are difficult and demanding to understand; whereas the presence of the body is weak, and the words are ineffective in their effect.
verses.11: I consider this to be a good thing, because those who have received the message through the letters, and who are present in this work, are indeed worthy of it.
verses.12: For we do not dare to compare or contrast ourselves with those who are similar to us. Instead, they measure and compare themselves to each other, but they do not find any similarity in themselves.
verses.13: We shall not boast about our own measurements, but according to the measure of the law that God has given us. We will even reach up to you as well.
verses.14: For we have not gone to you in an excessive manner, but we have even reached you through the gospel of Christ.
verses.15: Not in a boastful manner, for various reasons. Instead, we hope that your faith will grow according to our rules, to the extent that it can.
verses.16: To preach the good news to those who are far away from you, not in any other way than as a means of selling goods that already exist.
verses.17: But the one who boasts in the presence of others should also be able to do so.
verses.18: For it isn’t the person who represents himself that matters; what’s important is who the Lord considers worthy of being represented.
